summary: A shell opened in the tui waits and retries, saying why, when st refuses its attach for a reason that passes, instead of ending the tab

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: tui only. It sends the same requests, repeated at most once every five seconds for about a minute and a half; the daemon's answers and authority decisions are unchanged and the tui never guesses a host.
